<a id="init_actors"></a>
### [`init_actors`](../../../../src/actors/init_actors.asm#L18) `$8FF6`

*routine*

Then it sets $57 and $5c to 2 and the speed values $50, $58 and $60 from the lawn number $21. After lawn 16 it uses the maximum speed.
